6600: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.
6601: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
6606: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
6607: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.
6618: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
6632: Sit tall on the front edge of a chair with feet flat.
Extend your arms out in front of you.
Reach one hand diagonally down toward the opposite foot, rotating your torso.
Reach to the other side and keep alternating.
6648: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.
6692: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out the hips without leaning back.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar under control.
6693: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel beside the stack.
Hold the rope at the side of your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.
6698: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.
